Library.NoResultsSubtitle: Try a different search term or select another category.
Toolbar.SearchPlaceholder: Search title, publisher, developer or year…
Toolbar.ToggleDetails: Show or hide the details pane
Details.NoSelectionSubtitle: Select a game to see its details.
Wizard.Title: Add Game
Wizard.Step1Description: Choose the folder that contains the DOS game. Sub folders are scanned as well.
Wizard.FolderMissing: The selected folder does not exist.
Wizard.Step2Description: These EXE, BAT and COM files were found. Pick the one that starts the game.
Wizard.NoExecutablesFound: No EXE, BAT or COM files were found in this folder.
Wizard.LikelyUtility: Probably a setup or utility program
Wizard.Step3Description: Search MobyGames for cover art, description and genres.
Wizard.MetadataOptional: This step is optional — you can always add the details manually later.
Wizard.Step4Description: Check the entry and add it to your library.
Wizard.AlreadyInLibrary: This launch file is already in your library.
Edit.Title: Edit game
Edit.ManualFieldsHint: Fields you change here are protected against automatic metadata refreshes.
Field.Title: Title
DosBox.OverrideHint: Empty fields keep the value from the base dosbox.conf.
DosBox.AdditionalConfigHint: One entry per line, for example: [cpu] on its own line followed by cycles=20000.
DosBox.PreLaunchHint: DOS commands that run inside the mounted drive before the launch file.
Settings.Title: Settings
Settings.BaseConfigHint: Used as the base for every game. DosBoxxer never modifies this file. Leave empty to use the built-in default (starts games fullscreen, scaled with aspect ratio preserved), which is written to the program folder on first launch.
Settings.AdditionalArgumentsHint: Passed to DOSBox as separate arguments. No shell is involved.
Settings.CloseAfterExit: Close DOSBox when the game exits
Settings.SsHint: ScreenScraper's API requires developer credentials (Developer ID + password), issued once on request via the screenscraper.fr forum; enter them below. With them you can scrape as a guest. A user account (below) is optional and raises your quota.
Settings.SsSystemIdHint: 135 is "PC Dos" in the ScreenScraper system list. Leave empty to search all systems.
Settings.LanguageHint: The language changes immediately, no restart needed.
Settings.AutoFetchMetadata: Search metadata automatically in the wizard
Refresh.Title: Refresh metadata
Refresh.Message: Select the fields to update for "{0}".
Refresh.OverwriteManual: Overwrite manually edited fields as well
Refresh.NoProviderId: This game is not linked to a MobyGames entry yet. Use the search to link it.
Confirm.RemoveGameMessage: Do you want to remove "{0}" from your library?
Confirm.RemoveGameHint: The game files on your disk are not touched. Only the library entry is removed.
Confirm.RemoveCachedMedia: Also delete cached cover art and screenshots
Confirm.ClearCacheMessage: Delete all cached images and metadata? They will be downloaded again when needed.
Confirm.DiscardMessage: Your changes have not been saved. Discard them?
Status.Offline: No connection to the metadata provider — the library works offline.
Error.Title: Something went wrong
Error.DosBoxNotConfigured: No DOSBox executable is configured. Please set it in the settings.
Error.DosBoxNotFound: The configured DOSBox executable no longer exists.
Error.BaseConfigNotFound: The configured dosbox.conf no longer exists.
Error.GameDirectoryMissing: The game folder no longer exists. It may have been moved or deleted.
Error.LaunchFileMissing: The launch file no longer exists. Please select a new one.
Error.ConfigWriteFailed: The DOSBox configuration for this game could not be written.
Error.ScreenScraperUnreachable: ScreenScraper cannot be reached at the moment.
Error.RateLimited: The ScreenScraper request limit has been reached. Please try again later.
Error.DeveloperAccessRequired: ScreenScraper rejected the developer credentials. Developer API access (Developer ID + password) is required — request it once on the screenscraper.fr forum. A user account alone is not enough.
Error.NotConfigured: The metadata provider is not configured. Enter your MobyGames API key in the settings.
Error.InvalidResponse: The response from ScreenScraper could not be read.
Error.ImageLoadFailed: The image could not be loaded.
Error.MediaDownloadFailed: The media files could not be downloaded.
Error.DatabaseError: The library database could not be accessed.
Error.OpenFolderFailed: The folder could not be opened.
Error.Unexpected: An unexpected error occurred. See the log for details.
Error.MangledPathWarning: DOSBox only supports 8.3 file names. These names had to be shortened and may not resolve: {0}
Lightbox.Title: Screenshot {0} of {1}
Settings.MobyHint: MobyGames' API needs a private API key, issued on request (you contact MobyGames once). Enter it below. MobyGames is one of the best databases for DOS-era games; note its rate limit of one request every 10 seconds.
Settings.MobyPlatformIdHint: 2 is "DOS" in the MobyGames platform list. Change it only to scrape a different platform.
Error.InvalidApiKey: The MobyGames API key was rejected. Check the key in the settings.
Error.ProviderUnreachable: The metadata provider cannot be reached at the moment.
Settings.MetadataProviderHint: Choose which online database enriches your games. Enter the credentials for the selected provider below.
Settings.IgdbHint: IGDB is free and instant: create an application at dev.twitch.tv to get a Client ID and Client Secret. Good DOS coverage; the API allows ~4 requests per second.
Settings.IgdbPlatformIdHint: 13 is "DOS" in the IGDB platform list. Change it only to scrape a different platform.
Settings.RawgHint: RAWG offers a free API key instantly on signup at rawg.io. Note that RAWG's coverage of DOS-era games is thinner and its cover art is often modern.
Settings.RawgPlatformIdHint: RAWG has no dedicated DOS platform, so leave this empty to search all platforms.
Toolbar.BulkAdd: Add multiple games from a folder
BulkAdd.Title: Add multiple games
BulkAdd.PickParent: Select the folder that contains the game folders
BulkAdd.NoSubdirectories: The selected folder has no sub folders to import.
BulkAdd.NoScraperMessage: No metadata provider is configured, so games will be added without cover art or descriptions. Continue anyway?
BulkAdd.NoScraperHint: You can set up a provider in Settings → Metadata provider and refresh the games later.
Settings.ProviderComparison: MobyGames gives the best results but requires a paid API plan. IGDB is free and good, but has a more involved setup (a Twitch application). RAWG is free and the easiest to set up, but its results are weaker.
Wizard.Step5Description: DosBoxxer can look up where this game stores its savegames so they can be synchronised to the cloud. Pick the matching title, or configure the paths yourself.
Savegame.EntriesHint: Paths are relative to the folder of the start file (usually the game folder). Use a pattern like *.SAV for wildcards, or a folder name to include everything inside it.
Savegame.InvalidPattern: That path is not valid (absolute paths and ".." are not allowed).
Cloud.Intro: Connect a Google account to synchronise your savegames across computers. Everything works normally without it — cloud sync is entirely optional.
Cloud.NotConfigured: Enter an OAuth client ID and secret to enable cloud saves.
Cloud.Connecting: Waiting for authorization in your browser…
Cloud.ConnectHint: Authorization opens in your browser. You never enter your Google password in DosBoxxer.
Cloud.ConnectFailed: Could not connect to Google Drive. Please try again.
Cloud.NetworkError: Could not reach Google. Check your internet connection.
Sync.Summary: {0} uploaded, {1} downloaded, {2} up to date, {3} conflict(s)
Sync.NotConfigured: Cloud saves are not set up
Sync.NoSavegames: This game has no savegame configuration.
Conflict.Title: Resolve savegame conflict
Conflict.Message: These savegames changed both on this computer and in the cloud. Choose which version to keep.
Conflict.ApplyToAll: Apply my choice to all conflicts
Conflict.UseLocalDesc: The local copy overwrites the cloud version.
Conflict.UseCloudDesc: The cloud copy overwrites the local version.
PreLaunch.FailedMessage: The cloud saves could not be synchronised before starting the game. Your local savegames are unchanged.
PostExit.FailedMessage: Your new savegame is safe on this computer, but it could not be uploaded to the cloud. It will be uploaded on the next sync.
